## List programs

`GET /v1/programs` (SDK method `listPrograms`)

The programs of the projects the caller may view, by name. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_PROGRAMS=on`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectId` | string | no | Only this project's programs. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ProgramList](/api/reference/types/#programlist) (`application/json`). The programs.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Save a new program

`POST /v1/programs` (SDK method `createProgram`)

Saves a program and its version 1; needs operator on the project. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_PROGRAMS=on`.

**Body**: [CreateProgramBody](/api/reference/types/#createprogrambody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Program](/api/reference/types/#program) (`application/json`). The program.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Run a program

`POST /v1/programs/{programId}/runs` (SDK method `runProgram`)

Runs a version (default the latest) with `input`, checked against its input schema, in a session of its own as the caller, with no model: code mode runs the program, whose tool calls go through the same rules, approvals and audit as any session's. Needs operator on the project. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_PROGRAMS=on`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `programId` | string | yes |  |

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [RunProgramBody](/api/reference/types/#runprogrambody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [ProgramRun](/api/reference/types/#programrun) (`application/json`). The run, ended.
- `202`: [ProgramRun](/api/reference/types/#programrun) (`application/json`). The run, still running.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Cancel a program run

`POST /v1/programs/{programId}/runs/{runId}/cancel` (SDK method `cancelProgramRun`)

Stops a running run (its session's run is aborted); an ended run is answered as it is. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_PROGRAMS=on`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `programId` | string | yes |  |
| `runId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ProgramRun](/api/reference/types/#programrun) (`application/json`). The run.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Resume a waiting program run

`POST /v1/programs/{programId}/runs/{runId}/resume` (SDK method `resumeProgramRun`)

Supplies the value a `waitForInput()` step waits on (`waitId`, from the run's `waitingOn`), checked against the step's schema, or an `error` its `await` throws. The run resumes: its script runs again from the top, and every call an earlier activation finished comes from the run's journal. Needs operator on the project. Experimental: served only where the deployment also sets `KANTEL_PROGRAM_WAITS=on`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `programId` | string | yes |  |
| `runId` | string | yes |  |

**Body**: [ResumeProgramRunBody](/api/reference/types/#resumeprogramrunbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [ProgramRun](/api/reference/types/#programrun) (`application/json`). The run, ended, or waiting again.
- `202`: [ProgramRun](/api/reference/types/#programrun) (`application/json`). The run, resumed and still running.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List a program run's journal

`GET /v1/programs/{programId}/runs/{runId}/steps` (SDK method `listProgramRunSteps`)

Each tool call and wait the run made, in order, with how many later activations took it from the journal instead of running it again. Experimental: served only where the deployment also sets `KANTEL_PROGRAM_WAITS=on`.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
